addons.name: Anime archetypes
addons.description: The characters every anime has – the hero who never gives up, the eternal rival, the wise mentor, the mascot, the sealed evil – as cards for your anime decks.
addons.author: MEZTKING

addons.name: Anime upscaling models
addons.description: Real-ESRGAN's AnimeVideo v3 models (2×, 3× and 4×: small and fast, made for anime) and 4xHFA2k (4×, trained on anime art). Upscayl's Digital Art model is still the default.
addons.author: xinntao, Real-ESRGAN, Phhofm – collected by Upscayl

addons.name: Art only
addons.description: Just the art of a card, for your own cards: cut out of its window (Scryfall's own cut-out for real cards), or – for full-art and borderless cards – with the name bar, type line, text box, P/T and border painted over by a content-aware fill that rebuilds them from the art around them (offline; AI fill too when AI is switched on). Adds Keep only the art to the Decklists page.
addons.author: MEZTKING

page.title: Art only
page.tooltip: The art of a card without its frame and text

addons.name: Card database
addons.description: Every Magic card on your PC from Scryfall's bulk data (import the file you downloaded, or download it here). Search with filters (legal in Commander, Standard, Modern…), pick random cards, build a whole deck for your format – around a commander, or around a key card in fours for 60-card formats – in a play style and themes you pick, see the cards, pick the ones you want or start a new deck with all of them, and add cards as real cards or as your own cards to edit. Decklists look cards up here first.
addons.author: MEZTKING

page.title: Card database
page.tooltip: Every Magic card: search, random cards, build a deck

addons.name: Card prices
addons.description: What the real cards of your deck, or a decklist, cost at TCGplayer and Cardmarket: the cheapest printing of each, totals per store and the cheapest mix, in your currency – with a TCGplayer Mass Entry link and a Cardmarket wants list. Uses the Card database add-on's prices when it's installed.
addons.author: MEZTKING

page.title: Card prices
page.tooltip: What the real cards cost at TCGplayer and Cardmarket

addons.name: Deck check
addons.description: Checks exported decks (.deck.json) before they're played in the MTG engine: data to fix in MSE Studio, wording that needs your ruling, and for every card whether the Forge rules engine can run it as it is, needs new engine code, or has to be resolved by hand. Works only on files you pick; nothing is sent anywhere by itself. With AI switched on in MSE Studio, Check keywords with AI asks your chosen AI service about the deck's keywords.
addons.author: MEZTKING

page.title: Deck check
page.tooltip: Check exported decks for the MTG engine

addons.name: Deck notes
addons.description: A notes page for each deck: ideas, to-dos and cards to fix, saved by itself as notes.md in the deck's folder. Can make a checklist of every card in the deck.
addons.author: MEZTKING

page.title: Notes
page.tooltip: Notes and to-dos for this deck

addons.name: Deck sharing
addons.description: Share decks with friends: pick a folder you all share on OneDrive, Google Drive or Dropbox and your decks and theirs show up on one list, with a picture, who shared it and a note. Open a friend's deck and it's added to your decks (never over one of yours). Or send a deck as one file on Discord or by e-mail.
addons.author: MEZTKING

page.title: Deck sharing
page.tooltip: Share decks with friends through a shared folder or a file

addons.name: Dragon cards
addons.description: Twelve dragon ideas in every colour, with a legendary dragon commander, ramp for dragon decks and dragon tokens.
addons.author: MEZTKING

addons.name: Fast upscaling models
addons.description: Light, quick 4× models for big batches: Real-ESRGAN General v3 (and its wide-and-deep version) and 4xLSDIRCompactC3.
addons.author: xinntao, Real-ESRGAN, Phhofm – collected by Upscayl

addons.name: Gear and auras
addons.description: Equipment and Auras for Voltron decks (one big creature with lots of gear), plus the creatures that find and pay for them.
addons.author: MEZTKING

addons.name: Lore
addons.description: Build your deck's world: its characters, places, groups, items and events, what each is, and the cards about each. Gathers them from your cards (legendary cards, who speaks in flavour text), finds a series' characters online, looks up their stories, and makes cards for them with abilities that fit. Kept with the deck as lore.json; saves as a text file.
addons.author: MEZTKING

page.title: Lore
page.tooltip: The deck's world: characters, places, groups, items and events

addons.name: More example cards
addons.description: 21 more lists for Card ideas – 407 cards of our own: decks of a creature type (Vampires, Zombies, Elves, Goblins, Angels, Merfolk, Knights, Beasts), play styles (spells, +1/+1 counters, artifacts, enchantments, graveyard, life gain, tokens, poison, lands, control), two-colour pairs, planeswalkers and tokens to print. Each has commanders and the cards a deck of its kind needs.
addons.author: MEZTKING

addons.name: More formats
addons.description: Six more deck formats to choose on the Deck page and in the New deck window: Duel Commander, PreDH, Premodern, Penny Dreadful, Historic and Timeless – their deck size, copies, life and which real cards are allowed (Scryfall's lists). Make your own under My formats.
addons.author: MEZTKING

addons.name: NMKD upscaling models
addons.description: NMKD Siax (4×: a universal upscaler for clean and lightly compressed pictures) and NMKD Superscale (4×: sharp results on clean, artifact-free pictures).
addons.author: NMKD – collected by Upscayl

addons.name: Paint studio
addons.description: Paint card art like in a real painting app: layers with blend modes, clipping and locks; 34 brushes (pencils, inks, oils, gouache, watercolour with wet edges, airbrushes, chalk, charcoal, sprays, glows, sparkles) and your own in Brush studio; pen pressure, smudging and blending, symmetry, straight lines and neat ellipses by holding the pen still, selections and the magic wand, fill, gradients, liquify, shapes, moving and resizing, 14 adjustments (colour, levels, blur, sharpen, glow, gradient map…), a tracer that splits any picture into ink lines, flat colours and shading to paint your own version over, a colour wheel with harmonies and palettes, touch gestures, and the card's frame over the painting while you paint. Paintings are .ora files Krita and GIMP open; Photoshop layers can be brought in.
addons.author: MEZTKING

page.title: Paint studio
page.tooltip: Paint your cards' art with layers and real-feeling brushes

addons.name: Photo and restoration models
addons.description: 4× models for photos, screenshots and damaged pictures: 4xNomos8kSC, 4xLSDIR, 4xLSDIRplusC, Uniscale Restore and "Unknown" (a model Upscayl once shipped by mistake that people liked).
addons.author: Phhofm, Kim2091, unknown – see Upscayl's notes – collected by Upscayl

addons.name: Picture grabber
addons.description: Collect card art from anywhere: every picture on a web page (Pinterest, ArtStation, a booru, Reddit, any site) saved full size with its credit, and live mode – every picture you copy and every new screenshot is saved into the deck's art folder by itself.
addons.author: MEZTKING

page.title: Pictures
page.tooltip: Picture grabber: pictures from web pages, the clipboard and screenshots

addons.name: Playtest
addons.description: Goldfish your deck: deal opening hands (with the free mulligan of multiplayer Commander), keep or mulligan, play turns – draw, play cards, tap them, life and poison counters – and see the odds of having the cards you need by a given turn. Plays your own cards as MSE draws them, real cards with their real pictures, or any decklist (Decklists → Playtest). Until MSE Studio 0.25 this page came with the app.
addons.author: MEZTKING

page.title: Playtest
page.tooltip: Playtest · opening hands, turns and odds

addons.name: Video capture
addons.description: Take screenshots of episodes with a hotkey, straight into the right episode folder – even while the video is fullscreen. Adds the Video capture page.
addons.author: MEZTKING

page.title: Video capture
page.tooltip: Capture screenshots of episodes into episode folders
